title: Complex trust income — Hollis Family Trust
instructions: The Hollis Family Trust is a complex trust. Capital gains are allocated to corpus under the trust instrument and are not distributed. Compute its 2025 amounts. Round to the nearest dollar.

exhibits.title: 2025 trust data
exhibits.content:
| Item | Amount |
|---|---:|
| Taxable interest | 30,000 |
| Qualified dividends | 20,000 |
| Tax-exempt municipal interest | 10,000 |
| Long-term capital gain (allocated to corpus) | 15,000 |
| Trustee fees (charged to income) | 6,000 |
| Discretionary distribution to the beneficiary | 40,000 |

Trustee fees are allocated to tax-exempt income in proportion to income (10,000 ÷ 60,000). The complex trust exemption is $100.

rows.label: Trustee fees deductible by the trust
rows.explanation: 6,000 × 50,000 ÷ 60,000 = **5,000**; 1,000 is allocable to tax-exempt income and nondeductible.

rows.label: Distributable net income
rows.explanation: 30,000 + 20,000 + 10,000 − 6,000 = **54,000**; capital gains allocated to corpus are excluded.

rows.label: Distribution deduction
rows.explanation: 40,000 × (taxable DNI 45,000 ÷ DNI 54,000) = **33,333**; the tax-exempt portion isn't deductible.

rows.label: Amount taxable to the beneficiary
rows.explanation: The beneficiary includes the taxable share of the distribution: **33,333**; 6,667 keeps its tax-exempt character.

rows.label: Trust taxable income
rows.explanation: 65,000 − 5,000 − 33,333 − 100 = **26,567** (including the 15,000 capital gain kept in corpus).

rows.label: Who is taxed on the $15,000 capital gain?
rows.explanation: Gains allocated to corpus and not distributed are excluded from DNI and taxed to the trust.

rows.label: The character of the beneficiary's $40,000 distribution is:
options: A proportionate share of each class of DNI, including tax-exempt interest
rows.answer: A proportionate share of each class of DNI, including tax-exempt interest
rows.explanation: Distributions carry out each class of income in proportion to DNI.

rows.label: Due date of the 2025 Form 1041 for a calendar-year trust
rows.explanation: Form 1041 is due on the 15th day of the fourth month after year-end.
